items.title: What to expect ahead of the Fed's September interest rate decision
items.summary: The Federal Reserve will announce its policy decision on Sept. 16, with expectations of a rate hike amid elevated inflation and CPI prices.  Kevin Gordon, Head of Macro Research and Strategy at the Schwab Center for Financial Research, and Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferré join Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss the potential consequences of a rate hike.

items.title: Anthropic, OpenAI now want to tame the rapid pace of AI development
items.summary: Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman are in agreement that the AI industry needs to pace its development. Yahoo Finance's Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian are joined by Business Insider Today executive editor Dan DeFrancesco to discuss the two business leaders' latest statements and what these sentiments may ultimately mean for the AI frontier.
